hypothesis: A causal 4h proxy for realized signed variation (positive semivariance minus negative semivariance, normalized by total realized variance) negatively predicts future returns cross-sectionally; low signed-variation assets may carry a long-side premium.
universe_rule: Top 80 current Binance Spot USDT symbols excluding stable/fiat-like bases, leveraged tokens, wrapped/gold proxies and reserved holdout. Signal-time eligibility requires >=365 days prior 4h history and >=10M USDT average daily quote volume over prior 30 days.

RSJ_PROXY_LOW.score: (sum positive r^2 - sum negative r^2) / sum r^2

RSJ_PROXY_LOW_BULL.market_regime: BTC close > EMA600 and BTC 30d return > 0

RSJ_PROXY_LOW_MOM.filter: bottom 25% signed-variation score and positive 30d momentum
RSJ_PROXY_LOW_MOM.market_regime: BTC close > EMA600 and BTC 30d return > 0
